verdict.rationale: SigNoz documents service accounts that grant programmatic API access without tying credentials to individual users, aimed at automation and integrations. It also documents roles as the core access-control unit, granting principals bundles of transactions, which implies service accounts can be scoped to least privilege. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that service-account credentials bind to custom fine-grained roles, key expiry/rotation details, agent-specific guidance for credentialing the MCP server or agents, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
